title: Whether the Agency Service Fee Comes Back on a Hotel Rate Plans Cancellation
content:
The agency service fee posted on a Hotel Rate Plans reservation is returned only where the rate plan booked charges no such fee, the desk keeping a fee the plan levies and returning one the plan does not.

## The rule

1. Where an agency service fee has been posted on the reservation and the rate plan booked charges an agency service fee, 0 percent of the service element is returned.
2. Where an agency service fee has been posted on the reservation and the rate plan booked charges no agency service fee, 100 percent of the service element is returned.
3. In every other case 100 percent of the service element is returned.

The service element is the agency service fee posted on the reservation. A plan charges an agency service fee when the fee it carries stands above nothing.

## The fee each plan carries

| Rate plan | Agency booking service fee, USD | Charges such a fee |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Non-Refundable Saver Rate | 19.95 | yes |
| Advance Purchase 21 Rate | 17.95 | yes |
| Semi-Flexible Rate | 14.95 | yes |
| Standard Flexible Rate | 12.95 | yes |
| Member Flex Rate | 0.0 | no |
| Suite Flexible Rate | 9.95 | yes |
| All-Inclusive Flex Rate | 0.0 | no |

## The combinations

| A service fee stands on the folio | Plan charges such a fee | Share of the service element returned |
| --- | --- | --- |
| yes | yes | 0 percent |
| yes | no | 100 percent |
| no | yes | 100 percent |
| no | no | 100 percent |

## Worked on hypothetical figures

A service element of 12.95 USD posted on the reservation:

- On the Standard Flexible Rate, which charges 12.95 USD, 0 percent is returned, which is 0.00 USD.
- On the Member Flex Rate, which charges nothing, 100 percent is returned, which is 12.95 USD; a fee that found its way onto a folio under a plan levying none comes back in full.
- Where no service fee stood on the folio, the returned figure would be 100 percent of 0.00 USD, which is 0.00 USD.
